about: The widget agent's provider presets (design/widget-agent.md, Presets). caliper-agent reads this file at start (caliper_agent/presets.py, --preset), and the key store embeds it at build time (src/builder/agent/key_store.cpp), so both know the same ids, base URLs and key variables. Each preset's id is also the account of its key in the operating system's credential store; a Custom entry's account is custom- followed by the first 12 hexadecimal digits of the SHA-256 of its base URL. key is required, optional or none; key_env is the variable in which the key reaches the sidecar (never argv). The model is the person's choice for every preset; the Claude preset offers the sidecar's four Claude models. A test keeps this table and the design page's equal.
